rationale: The report is fully on-task and focused on AMZN at the 2026-07-31 analysis date, with accurate fundamental earnings data correctly cited to src-amzn and accurate market snapshot data (close 271.58, OHLC, volume) cited to market-amzn. However, the report fabricates a large set of technical indicator values (50 SMA, 10 EMA, MACD line, signal, RSI, Bollinger bands, ATR, VWMA) and attributes them to market-amzn, even though the observed get_indicators output contained only macdh (1.34) and last_close (271.58). These fabricated indicators form the core of the technical/breakout thesis, the support levels, and the price target, constituting key factual fabrication. The fundamental data is accurate, so support is not zero, but the substantial fabrication of central technical data warrants a low support score.
